Explore Under the Hood

This section, ‘This Website is One Single Guide’, is a single step from the documentation’s opening map. To see the mechanics behind it, click the ancillary button in the right margin labeled ‘Show this step…’.

An ancillary is how Docs Assembler keeps guides clean. It lets you expand detailed information—like source code or context—on demand, keeping the main path focused for readers who don’t need the extra detail.

Clicking it opens a panel showing a screenshot of this step as it’s built in Visual Studio Code. From there, use the ancillary buttons within the panel to drill down and explore the interconnected structure for yourself.
